proofAuthority.admittedBoundary: ordinary Scav target discrimination, map-level Location and Survived extraction shapes are proven; Customs/bigmap is independently pinned as an exact valid location target, while sub-location/zone restriction and kill-to-extract same-raid coupling are not

description.en: Customs is one of the few practical corridors for moving supplies between the industrial edge and the interior, and local Scav groups keep turning that route into an ambush line. Break the immediate threat and leave the area alive. I need movement restored, not a body-count campaign.
description.ru: Таможня — один из немногих практичных коридоров для переброски снабжения между промышленной окраиной и внутренними районами, а местные группы Диких постоянно превращают маршрут в линию засад. Сними непосредственную угрозу и выйди живым. Мне нужно восстановить движение, а не устроить кампанию по набиванию счётчика убийств.

started.en: Work Customs only. Break the local Scav threat, keep the contact bounded, and extract. Do not turn this into a sweep of every map or a ladder of larger kill counts.
started.ru: Работай только на Таможне. Сними местную угрозу со стороны Диких, не растягивай бой и выходи. Не превращай это в зачистку каждой карты или лестницу всё больших счётчиков убийств.

success.en: Movement through Customs is viable again. That was the objective; there is no value in repeating the same clearance with larger numbers.
success.ru: Движение через Таможню снова возможно. Это и было целью; повторять ту же зачистку с большими цифрами бессмысленно.

operation.objectiveIntent: One Customs-bound route-security operation against ordinary Scav threats with successful extraction. The product intent is same-raid clearance-and-extract, but that temporal coupling must remain fail-closed until exact evaluator/reset ordering is proven.

selectedLocation.selectionReason: Customs is a coherent logistics-corridor setting for a route-security contract, and bigmap is already pinned as an exact valid Customs location target by the selected vanilla VisitPlace proof.

economyReview.review: The bounded six-Scav Customs security operation at level 21 stays materially below the pinned vanilla Elimination median in XP and RUB, below the overall vanilla standing median, grants no item or permanent unlock, and therefore does not create a reward or stock faucet.
